_comment: Each show's own logo, cut from the organiser's material in images/brand-masters/ (docs/15 §10). `plate` is the ground the logo was drawn on — the site always shows it on that colour so a raster edge never shows. Built by `npm run logos` into public/brand/<id>/logo.{webp,png}. AGROPRO and WORLD EDU have no logo file yet: they keep the typeset wordmark until the organiser sends one.
